QQQ 690/681p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.655 is 1.607x the 1.03 credit — hard stop triggers at 1.5x (1.545). This breach has persisted across multiple cycles; the loss has not recovered to below threshold despite intraday green. Rules are rules.

QQQ 677/668p.reasoning: Mid-cost 1.10 is above the 1.07 credit entry (currently a loser), and two QQQ put verticals on the same expiry represent unacceptable single-underlying concentration regardless of strike separation. After closing the 690/681p, this position must also close to eliminate the double QQQ exposure.

SLV 61.5/60.5p.reasoning: Mid-cost 0.50 is now slightly below the 0.55 credit entry (profitable), short strike 2.3% OTM, 131 DTE with no time pressure, and fully uncorrelated to the QQQ book being unwound.
